description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy (%) of different models as a function of the number of frames, with the x-axis representing the "Number of Frames" on a linear scale ranging from 10 to 65, and the y-axis showing "Accuracy (%)" on a linear scale from 40 to 54. The plot compares four models: "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" (blue line with circular markers), "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" (green line with circular markers), "PLLaVA (DP 16)" (red line with square markers), and a fourth model represented by an orange line with square markers. The blue line starts at approximately 53.2% accuracy at 10 frames and increases slightly to around 54.0% at 65 frames. The green line begins at about 52.6% and rises to approximately 54.0% at 65 frames. The red line starts at around 45.8% and steadily decreases to about 42.2% at 65 frames. The orange line starts at approximately 45.2% and declines to around 39.5% at 65 frames. All lines show a general trend of increasing accuracy for the "Ours" models and decreasing accuracy for the "PLLaVA" and the unnamed model.
